As International Business Machs (IBM) Stock Price Declined, Berkshire Hathaway Has Cut Position by $5.35 Billion; As Cyberark Software LTD (CYBR) Stock Rose, Brown Capital Management Increased by $644,438 Its Stake
April 26, 2018 - By Maria Brooks
Warren Buffett decreased its stake in International Business Machs (IBM) by 94.47% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Berkshire Hathaway Inc sold 34.98M shares as the company’s stock declined 0.39% with the market. The hedge fund run by Warren Buffett held 2.05 million shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $314.21M, down from 37.03 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Berkshire Hathaway Inc who had been investing in International Business Machs for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $134.98B market cap company. The stock increased 0.40% or $0.59 during the last trading session, reaching $146.53. About 1.64M shares traded. International Business Machines Corporation (NYSE:IBM) has declined 12.58% since April 26, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 24.13% the S&P500.
Brown Capital Management Llc increased its stake in Cyberark Software Ltd (CYBR) by 30.98% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Brown Capital Management Llc bought 15,718 shares as the company’s stock rose 19.29% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 66,449 shares of the prepackaged software company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $2.75 million, up from 50,731 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Brown Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Cyberark Software Ltd for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $1.90B market cap company. The stock increased 1.64% or $0.86 during the last trading session, reaching $53.34. About 431,773 shares traded. CyberArk Software Ltd. (NASDAQ:CYBR) has risen 2.02% since April 26, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 9.53% the S&P500.
Among 33 analysts covering International Business Machines ( NYSE:IBM ), 13 have Buy rating, 4 Sell and 16 Hold. Therefore 39% are positive. International Business Machines had 129 analyst reports since July 21, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. On Monday, September 25 the stock rating was maintained by KeyBanc Capital Markets with “Hold”. The firm has “Market Perform” rating given on Tuesday, July 19 by BMO Capital Markets. Goldman Sachs maintained International Business Machines Corporation (NYSE:IBM) on Tuesday, October 18 with “Neutral” rating. Wedbush maintained International Business Machines Corporation (NYSE:IBM) rating on Thursday, January 18. Wedbush has “Hold” rating and $185.0 target. The firm earned “Buy” rating on Wednesday, October 21 by S&P Research. The firm earned “Hold” rating on Tuesday, August 22 by KeyBanc Capital Markets. As per Wednesday, August 23, the company rating was maintained by Morgan Stanley. The stock has “Underweight” rating by Barclays Capital on Wednesday, October 14. BMO Capital Markets maintained International Business Machines Corporation (NYSE:IBM) on Wednesday, August 30 with “Hold” rating. The rating was maintained by Stifel Nicolaus with “Buy” on Thursday, October 5.
Berkshire Hathaway Inc, which manages about $191.24 billion US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 31.24 million shares to 165.33 million shares, valued at $27.98B in 2017Q4, according to the filing.
